text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I spotted
Mejiro Ryan looking deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I wonder if there's anyone who'll go with me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I was planning to go to the aquarium this weekend, but my friend couldn't make it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The admission tickets I got expire this weekend, so I was wondering what to do...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me.
Trainer, are you free this weekend?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, why don't we go together? To the aquarium!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoaaah~... It's so fantastical!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There are so many colorful fish, it feels like an underwater flower garden!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, did you know?
Apparently aquariums are quite the hot spot these days.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, apparently every aquarium has its own special attractions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
For example, an aquarium with lots of jellyfish,
or one where you can touch dolphins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this aquarium
exhibits quite unusual creatures.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's written right there on the sign.
"Mysterious Creatures Gather! Thrilling and Exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of critters are here~!
Let's go take a look, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Pretty fish, uniquely shaped fish...
There really are so many different kinds of creatures, aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder who else is out there...
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-No... That's not it, but...
something about the area around us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, a-aren't there... only c-c-couples here?!
Just as Mejiro Ryan said, there were many young couples around enjoying the aquarium.
choice_data_list: It really lives up to its reputation as a hot spot, huh.
It really lives up to its reputation as a hot spot, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hauu~, even without thinking hard about it,
it was totally obvious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, their faces are so close together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, no, no!
I came here to look at the fish!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah~... Over there, they've got their arms crossed...
choice_data_list: Shall we get something cold to drink?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, exactly!
There's nothing better than a sports drink at a time like this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Gulp... pufaaah~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ I've calmed down now.
There were couples everywhere, so I got totally flustered.

text_block_list.name: Person in a Couple A
text_block_list.text: Tired from walking? Let's take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Person in a Couple B
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Can I lean on you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"T-T-Trainer-san!
I've calmed down now, so let's hurry and go!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew... S-Somehow I've gotten so exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So this is what the sign meant
by 'Heart-Pounding Excitement!'...

Though I had my doubts about that,
I enjoyed the aquarium with Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, right!
Focus on the fish tank, stay mindful of the extraocular muscles~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no!! It's nothing!
It's nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Locking eyes with Trainer
in the reflection of the aquarium glass... Does this mean...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "This is the exact same situation I read in Volume 6 of ‘Marine Lover’...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Their eyes meet through the glass of the tank...
Only then realizing their feelings are mutual—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, stop overthinking things,
and focus on the fish!
(...*glance*...... *glance*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaah~! I keep accidentally
making eye contact with Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So *this* is what it means to be totally thrilled and excited~!

I enjoyed the aquarium alongside Mejiro Ryan,
who was getting all hyped up on her own.
